moments.title: Carabao Cup Fourth Round Clashes
moments.blurb: The Carabao Cup (EFL Cup) fourth round continues tonight with several Premier League teams battling for a quarter-final spot, including Liverpool vs Chelsea.

angles.name: Big Match Tonight
angles.copy: Tonight, it's Liverpool vs Chelsea in the Carabao Cup! Who are you backing to go through to the quarter-finals?

angles.name: Midweek Football Drama
angles.copy: More Carabao Cup action tonight: Man City face Brighton, Bournemouth take on Aston Villa, plus Sunderland vs Brentford and Fulham vs Crystal Palace. Any upsets on the cards?

moments.title: Happy Birthday, Frank Ocean
moments.blurb: Grammy-winning R&B and hip-hop artist Frank Ocean turns 39 today.

angles.name: Celebrate Frank Ocean
angles.copy: Channel Orange, Blonde, or Endless? What's your go-to Frank Ocean track to celebrate his 39th birthday today?

angles.name: R&B Icon
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy 39th birthday to the incredible Frank Ocean! His influence on R&B is undeniable.

moments.title: Brad Paisley Turns 54
moments.blurb: Award-winning American country music singer-songwriter Brad Paisley celebrates his 54th birthday today.

angles.name: Country Star Birthday
angles.copy: Happy 54th Birthday to country music legend Brad Paisley! What's your favourite song from the 'Alcohol' hitmaker?

moments.title: Telma Hopkins is 78
moments.blurb: Singer and actress Telma Hopkins, best known as part of Tony Orlando and Dawn and for her role in 'Family Matters', celebrates her 78th birthday.

angles.name: Dawn's Diva
angles.copy: Candida! Happy 78th Birthday to Telma Hopkins, a voice of the 70s with Tony Orlando and Dawn. What a legend!

moments.title: J. Cole at Co-op Live Manchester
moments.blurb: American rapper J. Cole brings his 'The Fall-Off Tour' to Co-op Live in Manchester tonight.

angles.name: Cole World in Manchester
angles.copy: Manchester! J. Cole is in town tonight at Co-op Live for 'The Fall-Off Tour'. Who's heading there?

moments.title: Tokio Hotel at OVO Arena Wembley
moments.blurb: German pop-rock band Tokio Hotel play London's OVO Arena Wembley tonight as part of their 2026 Arena Tour.

angles.name: Tokio Hotel Live
angles.copy: London, are you ready for Tokio Hotel? They're at OVO Arena Wembley tonight! What's your favourite TH track?

moments.title: The Great British Bake Off Continues
moments.blurb: The Great British Bake Off, featuring new judge Nigella Lawson, aired its latest episode last night on Channel 4.

angles.name: Bake Off Chat
angles.copy: Still thinking about last night's Bake Off? What was your favourite creation, and who are you rooting for this year, especially with Nigella Lawson in the tent?

angles.name: Soggy Bottoms and Showstoppers
angles.copy: Another week, another batch of bakes! Did you catch the latest Great British Bake Off on Channel 4? We're loving the new dynamic with Nigella Lawson!

moments.title: Carabao Cup: Everton vs Newcastle
moments.blurb: The Carabao Cup Fourth Round concludes tomorrow as Everton host Newcastle United in a highly anticipated clash.

angles.name: Tomorrow's Big Game
angles.copy: Looking ahead to tomorrow's Carabao Cup action: Everton vs Newcastle United. Who's making it through to the quarter-finals?

moments.title: Randy Jackson's 65th
moments.blurb: Randy Jackson, the youngest male sibling of the legendary Jackson family and former American Idol judge, turns 65 tomorrow.

angles.name: Jackson Family Birthday
angles.copy: Tomorrow, we celebrate Randy Jackson's 65th birthday! From The Jacksons to American Idol, what's your favourite Randy moment?

moments.title: Halloween Weekend Approaches
moments.blurb: Halloween falls on Saturday, October 31st, bringing a weekend of spooky celebrations across the UK.

angles.name: Spooky Season
angles.copy: It's almost Halloween weekend! What are your spooky plans? Trick-or-treating, costume parties, or a scary movie marathon?

angles.name: UK Halloween Events
angles.copy: From Alton Towers Scarefest to local pumpkin patches, the UK is getting spooky this weekend! What are the best Halloween events near you?

moments.title: Strictly's Halloween Week
moments.blurb: Strictly Come Dancing returns for its much-anticipated Halloween Week on Saturday, October 31st, promising a triple dance-off.

angles.name: Strictly Spooktacular
angles.copy: Get ready for Strictly's Halloween Week on Saturday! Who are you excited to see in their spooky costumes and what dance are you hoping for? Plus, a triple dance-off!

angles.name: Triple Dance-Off Anticipation
angles.copy: Halloween Week on Strictly is always epic, but this year's triple dance-off means even more drama! Who do you think will be in the bottom?

moments.title: Duran Duran Halloween Show
moments.blurb: Duran Duran play a special Halloween gig in London on Saturday, October 31st.

angles.name: New Wave Halloween
angles.copy: Hungry Like The Wolf this Halloween? Duran Duran are playing a special London show on Saturday! What's your top Duran Duran track?

moments.title: Grace Slick Turns 87
moments.blurb: Grace Slick, iconic lead singer of Jefferson Airplane and a key figure in 60s psychedelic rock, celebrates her 87th birthday on Friday.

angles.name: Psychedelic Pioneer
angles.copy: Happy 87th birthday to the legendary Grace Slick of Jefferson Airplane tomorrow! Her voice defined an era. What's your favourite track?

moments.title: Gavin Rossdale is 61
moments.blurb: Gavin Rossdale, frontman of the rock band Bush, celebrates his 61st birthday on Friday.

angles.name: Bush Frontman
angles.copy: Tomorrow marks Gavin Rossdale's 61st birthday! What's your favourite Bush anthem to crank up?

moments.title: Bonfire Night Next Week
moments.blurb: Guy Fawkes Night, or Bonfire Night, is celebrated across the UK on Thursday, November 5th, with many firework displays happening throughout the surrounding weekend.

angles.name: Remember, Remember...
angles.copy: Bonfire Night is next Thursday! Are you planning to head to a public display or light up some sparklers at home?

angles.name: Fireworks and Festivities
angles.copy: With Bonfire Night just a week away, we're getting ready for fireworks, bonfires, and toffee apples! What are your favourite Bonfire Night traditions?
